Start here — Boulders Beach.
100% recommended, fully protected right now. 18°C in the water. Grab your towel.
Cloudy for most of the day.

A world-famous penguin sanctuary within Table Mountain National Park, where a colony of around 3,000 endangered African penguins lives freely among 540-million-year-old granite boulders.
